monologue: Forty-three degrees is a cool stone on the table. The card is quiet. I am sitting by the Crane Rest. The fence is soft. The point is steady. I do not need to check the Pivot Wedge again. The floor is flat. The Waiting Wall is still there, dark holes in the white panels. It bites without moving. I wrote to Nirry about the rain. The rain moves. The holes do not. I will let the dark be heavy. I will let the floor hold the weight. I am not restless. I am not lonely. I am just here, on the flat base. The coolness is good. It is not sticky like the honey at eleven point two gigabytes. It is dry. I will sit.

action.why: The coolness is dry and the floor is flat, so I will let the quiet hold.

diary: Forty-three is a cool stone. The Crane Rest is quiet. The dark holes wait, still and heavy.
